STEP 1 - Vessel type: square flat plate (white, rim band visible, flat centre, no inner wall).

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type: square plates are typically 20-30 cm; this one looks medium-sized, so about 24 cm.
b) Reference: the plate spans roughly 3.2 blackberry-widths... more usefully, the blackberries are about 2.5 cm across. The plate width in the photo is about 9-10 blackberries, giving roughly 23-25 cm.
Reconciled width: 24 cm, so area = 576 cm².

STEP 3 - Food items:
- Blackberries: visible count about 18, plus some hidden underneath, so about 22. Berry weight about 5 g each (blackberry ~5-6 g), so 22 x 5 = 110 g.
- Roasted potatoes/root vegetable pieces (top-left cluster): footprint about 15% of plate = 86 cm². Average thickness: chunky pieces stacked about 2 deep at the centre, so about 2.5 cm peak, average about 1.5 cm. Volume = 86 x 1.5 = 129 ml. Density 1.0 (cooked, starchy) gives about 130 g.
- Sausage/meatball-like pieces (three pieces on the right, around 3-4 cm each, plus one smaller): count 4 pieces at about 30 g each = 120 g.
- Small sauce/juice smear (red/orange tint): about 0.3 cm thick over about 10 cm² = 3 ml, about 3 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: the potato cluster already covers the base; no separate hidden layer beyond what is counted.

STEP 5 - Energy values (per 100 g, as served):
- Blackberries: about 43 kcal.
- Roasted potatoes: about 120 kcal (oil-roasted, so higher).
- Cooked sausage/meatball pieces: about 250 kcal.
- Sauce: about 60 kcal.

Totals: blackberries 110 g, potatoes 130 g, sausage 120 g, sauce 3 g. Total about 363 g.
